findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 
Observed that facility does not have written procedures for Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events(Norovirus) and also does not have proper chemical to assist with cleaning a norovirus event. PIC was made aware and written procedures was provided by inspectors and PIC assured that facility will purchase EPA certified bleach soon. Ensure that having proper EPA certified chemical and written procedures are available to respond to a vomit/diarrheal event. 

Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

Separation. findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Date marking of TCS foods including but not limited to cheese, deli meats, and chicken were not observed during the inspection. Discussed date marking TCS food items with PIC. Ensure TCS food items stored in house longer than 24 hours are date marked and discarded if not used within 7 days. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.comment:
3-304.14: Observed wet wiping cloths being used with a spray bottle and sitting out on a ledge. Ensure single-use paper towels are used with spray sanitizer or wet wiping cloths are held in a sanitizer solution.
(A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The following surfaces are soiled: 1) ALL of the roll carts within the facility; 2) metal racks of the Victory upright cooler; and 3) handles of most the equipment. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1200 One small chipped floor tile in front of the salad prep. cooler. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floor around the front dough prep. area and especially around the dish machine are soiled. Make sure the wheels of the equipment are scrubbed and all the adjacent plumbing is scrubbed. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1220 The following surfaces need attention: 1) interior door frame of the dry goods closet; 2) in dry goods closet there is an electrical cover missing (look behind the Franks Red Sauce container); 3) 3-part sink has moldy caulking; 4) drainboard to dishmachine has a missing screw and the equipment has sunk beneath the caulkline; 5) ledge of the frontline dough prep. area is soiled and needs an additional paint-coat - discussed using plexiglass to protect the shutter. Maintain the facility so ceilings, walls, and attached equipment are in good repair. 
The baffles of the pizza hood are soiled. Clean the baffles.
